SPY, QQQ, & IWM are either at or around major support after making fresh lows today.

There are reversal signals on the 2 hr for SPY. & Reversal signals across the VIX to head lower to $16.
None on the Q’s.

If the SPY does not bounce off 753 and gets under 748 we are at major risks for flash crashes.

You need to remember that most NOT all of the geopolitical issues + yields + hike have been priced in already.

I do not know what is going to happen tmw.

If we take out 767 - SPY Target will be 796 and it’s going to be a short squeeze like you’ve never seen before.

If we take out 748 - SPY 700-680 will be our next target followed by 600 followed by 567.

My advice so you don’t lose money - market will get an ORB move (likely up) and then take profits and wait 5 mins before rate decision is made to enter.
You will get chopped to shit by theta unless you’re call selling or put selling.

If we pop up to 760 in am then I’d take profit there and wait. It is not worth it. Trust me.
@everyone
